notes.title: Hard-Mode Added! (Patch 1.1.4)
notes.content:
Added

   Hard-mode is now available if you have beaten the game at least once. In this mode, enemies are much more aggressive. Boogeyman drops a new currency.
   Added 3 new hard-mode exclusive outfits.
   Added a new achievement for buying all 3 hard-mode outfits.




Fixes

   Fixed a bug where the game would crash while trying to draw some shadows.
   Fixed a bug where Mr Sandman's pillars with Silver Stars and Gold Stars would spawn in the tutorial version of his temple.
   Fixed a bug in the tutorial where the Nightmare Creatures wouldn't get deleted if you restarted the fight against Boogeyman.
   Fixed a bug where the Cameraman boss's camera would get drawn at the wrong coordinates.
   Fixed a bug where you could still move around during Boogeyman's outro cinematic.
   Fixed a bug where the Dragon pet's fireball wouldn't deal any damage.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.3
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for sending us bugs and error messages!
If you find anything else, let us know on Discord: https://discord.gg/FFvZ965


Fixes

   Fixed a bug where the game would crash when some enemies were charging at your location.
   Fixed a bug where petting animals in local co-op would crash the game.
   Fixed a bug where some electric abilities and items would crash the game.
   Fixed a bug where entering the room to the Jester boss would crash the game.
   Fixed a bug where the game would crash when spawning in new enemies.
   Fixed a bug where you would see the wrong amount of Dream Catchers in the UI.
   Fixed a bug where exiting to the Main Menu during the end-game event, would start the game there instead of the bedroom.
   Fixed a bug where some abilities would sometimes spawn twice for double the damage.
   Fixed a bug where Boogeyman would continue to walk around the room after dying.
   Fixed some spelling errors.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.content:
Added

   Added a new Main Menu background.
   Added some new artwork for Steam.


Changes

   The Secondary ability is now prioritized if both triggers are pressed at the same time.
   The spawned dinosaurs from the Dinosaur outfit's Dinosaur Nest ability now deals 15-25 damage. (Was 35-45)
   The spawned bunnies from the Magician outfit's Bunny Hat ability now deals 15-25 damage. (Was 35-45)


Fixes

   Fixed a bug where the "Quick Restart" and "Return to Bedroom" buttons wouldn't work.
   Fixed a bug where you couldn't see the UI in Mr Sandman's temple.
   Fixed a bug where skipping a boss outro cinematic wouldn't allow you to mount for a few seconds.
   Fixed a bug where the "fastest game completion" was saved as a really low and wrong number. In order to save the correct time again in the future, that stat have been reset if it was low enough.
   The camera shouldn't fly away from Billy anymore when you Alt-Tab the game.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
Added

   Added a new sequence with the Boogeyman, after defeating the boss on level 3.


Changes

   The Cowboy outfit's Gunslinger ability has been changed. It now targets up to 6 enemies within line of sight and then quickly shoots one bullet at each targeted enemy. This way, you can't shoot 6 bullets at a boss to quickly kill it.
   Balanced a lot of outfits so their starting abilities are better at killing bosses.
   Removed some distracting icons from the wall in the puzzle room, to make it easier to understand what to do.
   All music in the game is now in Stereo instead of Mono.
   In the Audio menu, the volume now updates when you press the arrow buttons instead of when you press Apply.


Fixes

   Fixed a bug where the Princess outfit's Heart Arrows ability would crash the game. 
   Fixed a bug where the Tuba ability would crash the game.
   Fixed a bug where skipping the intro to the Jester boss and attacking immediately would crash the game.
   Fixed a bug where withdrawing teeth from the Dream Bank would crash the game.
   Fixed a bug where some electric abilities wouldn't damage tall bosses.
   The floor in Boogeyman's temple now sounds like carpet instead of gravel.
   Boogeyman now keeps his distance from walls, so his projectiles don't spawn inside them.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Added

   The Night Stars have now been replaced with 3 new types of stars; Bronze Stars, Silver Stars and Gold Stars. They are rewarded depending on the game's current level. The outfits are also linked to these new stars instead. Meaning that in order to buy some outfits, you now have to progress in the game.
   Added 2 pillars to Mr Sandman's temple where you can trade lower quality stars for a higher quality one.
   The boss fights have been redesigned to be more challenging and interesting. All bosses have new changes, some as small as the speed of their projectiles to a whole new set of attack patterns. 
   After each boss fight, Boogeyman's portal now show a fancy high-res version of the recently killed boss.
   If you try to use abilities while mounted, a red text now tells you that you can't do that.


Changes

   All your existing Night Stars have been converted into the new Bronze Stars.
   Updated Mr Sandman's dialogue after boss fights, so he explains more about the new stars.
   When buying something, the textbox now specify if it's an Ability or Item to make it more clear.
   In the Item menu, there's now always a visible "down arrow" to make it more clear that you can have more than 4 items.
   The enemy portal sprites have been updated with more details.
   In co-op, bosses now have twice the HP if both players are alive at the start of the fight.
   In co-op, when a dead player is revived after a boss fight, he now has 50% HP. (Was 100%)
   Changed the Bouncer's dialogue to make it more clear that you have to beat the game in order to enter the VIP room.
   The Masterboi outfits primary attack now hits all enemies in its path.
   The bees from the Queen Bee item now only deals 5-15 damage, to make boss fights harder. (Was 35-45)


Fixes

   When playing on a monitor with a resolution higher than 1080p, the GUI should now get drawn correctly.
   It's no longer posible to run over lava with the Dash ability.
   Fixed a bug where icons on the minimap would appear stretched.
   Enemies who charge towards Billy should now look in the correct direction.  
   Fixed some spelling errors.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Added

   Added some glowing particles to doors so they're easier to see in the dark rooms.  
   Added an exclamation mark icon over the mannequin in Mr Sandman's temple, so its easier for new players to see where to buy outfits.



Changes

   Abilities and Items on higher ranks are now more expensive. The prices now are 20, 35, 50, 65. (Was 20, 30, 40, 50)
   The Super Sleeping Pills item is now a rare/blue item, so it still costs 50 teeth.
   All pets now have the rare/blue rank and costs 50 teeth.  
   The "'Kick Me' Sign" item has been removed, since it broke the game by giving guaranteed crits on certain bosses.
   It's now eaiser to hit enemies with the bouncing Burning Tire and Basket Ball abilities.
   It's now eaiser to hit enemies with the Hair Dryer ability.
   The last lava pit in the tutorial is now 2 tiles wide, to teach players that they can roll over gaps wider than 1 tile.
   Mr Sandman's dialogue box no longer hides the important ability he talks about in the tutorial.



Fixes

   When playing on a monitor with a resolution higher than 1080p, the GUI should now get drawn correctly.
   Pet Food can no longer spawn on the Item Table in the VIP room, only on the Animal Table.
   Fixed a bug where the Burning Tire ability and the Basket Ball ability would get stuck inside walls.
   Fixed a bug where the ambush wouldn't start, while escorting Santa's Elf to Santa.
   Fixed a bug where a portal sound would play while using the stairs.
   Fixed a bug where Billy would get stuck while using the stairs.
   Fixed a bug where the boss room door would get unlocked when you interacted with something else.
   Fixed a bug where the Coupons item would give you the discount twice.
   Fixed a bug where the Sandman outfit's Falling Star ability would get stuck on dead bosses.
   Fixed a bug where a floor tile would get the wrong texture.
   Fixed a bug where some projectiles would hit enemies multiple times.
   Fixed a bug where sometimes explosions would not damage tall enemies and bosses.
   Fixed a bug where feared enemies were immune to knockback.
   Fixed a bug where the some button sprites were drawn in the wrong place when using a controller.

notes.title: Path 1.0.5
notes.content:
Changes

   The Boogeyman Doll in Billy's bedroom doesn't activate hard-mode anymore. It now says "Coming Soon" instead. This is since the current version of hard-mode is very broken and we need to fix it.
   The Sandman outfit's Night Star ability now deals 35-45 damage. (Was 70-90) 
   The Sandman outfit's Night Star ability doesn't bounce between enemies anymore.
   The Sandman outfit's Falling Star ability now hits fewer enemies, so you can't clear the whole room with one attack.
   The Grunt outfit's Grenade Launcher now deals 70-90 damage. (Was 105-135)
   The Farmer outfit's Double-Barreled Shotgun ability now deals 168-216 damage. (Was 144-192)
   The Chef outfit's Pepper Mill ability now deals 288-384 damage. (Was 216-264)
   The Trooper outfit's Laser Rifle ability now deals 15-20 damage. (Was 20-25)



Fixes

   Fixed a bug where the game would crash if an item or ability failed to spawn.
   Fixed a bug where the Lost and Found basket in Tooth Fairy's shop wouldn't give you anything.
   Fixed a bug where pet items you recieve for free didn't play a sound on pick up.
   Fixed a bug where the Freeboy outfit's Coilgun ability wouldn't damage enemies, even when passing through them.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Changes

   The Biker Cop outfit's Laser Speed Gun ability now deals 10-20 damage per tick. (Was 35-40)
   The Biker Cop outfit's Laser Speed Gun ability now has a cooldown of 1 second. (Was 1.5 seconds)



Fixes

   Fixed a bug where some electric abilities would crash the game.
   Fixed a bug where changing level would crash the game.
   Fixed a bug where the boss door was visible when its corridor was unexplored.
   Fixed a bug where the boss icon wasn't visible on the map.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Changes

   The Dentist Drill now gets destroyed after damaging Billy 3 times.



Fixes

   The Recycle Bin in Tooth Fairy's shop now have the correct discount if you have the Coupons item.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Added

   Added a new Trash quality rank for Abilities and Items that are bad enough to be free.
   You can now find a "Lost and Found" basket in the Tooth Fairy's Shop, which gives you a random Trash quality Ability or Item for free.
   Added a Dream Bank to the final level, if the player has unlocked it.


Changes

   The boss doors now have to be manually opened, so you don't run inside by mistake.
   The Scientist NPC can no longer spawn downstairs, since the shop and boss room are most likely already found.
   The "Tooth Stone" ability has been removed from the game.
   Some Abilities and Items have now had their rank changed and moved to the new Trash rank.
   After falling into lava, Billy is now protected from falling in again for 1 second.  
   The "Pego Bricks" ability now have increased collision box, so enemies are easier to hit.
   The bees spawned from the "Queen Bee" item now deals 35-45 damage each. (Was 70-90)
   The bees spawned from the "Queen Bee" item and the "Bee Grenade" ability no longer benefit from crit increasing items.
   Updated the info text for the Dentist Drill, so it tells you how many teeth you can get and also its chance to damage you.
   You now get 5-10 teeth from the Dentist Drill. (Was 3-6)
   Portals now tell you if they lead to the "Boss Room Corridor" instead of "Level 2".
   Updated some dialogues.



Fixes

   Fixed a bug where the "Frisbee", "Soda Rocket" and "Surstromming" abilities would bounce between to few enemies.  
   Fixed a bug where the "Coupons" item would give the wrong discount.
   Pets now pathfind to different coordinates, so they don't overlap with each other.
   Fixed a bug where the Farmer outfit's "Pichfork" ability would move enemies inside wall.
   Fixed a bug where it was posible to remove the buttons on the Game Over screen, using Esc.
   Pets no longer attack enemies if Billy is dead.
   Mr Sandman now has audible footstep sounds in the Tutorial.
   Fixed a bug where the abilities in the shop and on the Pirate NPC's table would be drawn at the wrong depth.
   Fixed a bug where Mr Sandman would use the wrong color of Billy's pyjamas in a sentence.
   Fixed a bug where "Outfits Unlocked" would show the incorrect amount.
   Fixed some spelling errors.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Changes

   It's now posible to control Billy's direction while in the middle of a dive roll. This will make it easier to avoid rolling into danger by mistake.
   The "Blast Shield" item now reduces damage taken from explosions by 100%. (Was 75%)
   Changed the name of the Grunt outfit's primary ability to "SMG", for copyright reasons. (Was "MP5"). 
   Changed the rank of the "Scroll of Shop Portal" ability to "Common". (Was "Uncommon")
   Changed the rank of the "Tuba" ability to "Uncommon". (Was "Common")
   Changed the attack range of the "Tuba" ability. Enemies now get damaged as long as they're in line of sight.


Fixes
  
 The "Soda Rocket" and "Surstromming" abilities no longer get destroyed instantly if no enemies are around.
   Fixed a bug where your pets could absorb all boss projectiles, while only taking damage from 1 of them.
   Fixed a bug where the abilities on the Pirate NPC's table would be drawn at the wrong depth.
   Fixed a bug where a wall would show the wrong texture.
   Fixed a bug where Mr Sandman would give you the wrong dialogue if you skip the tutorial.
   The controller "interact" button is now visible when it's time to collect a Night Star after boss fights.
   The correct sprite is now shown for the controller "interact" button. 
   Fixed a bug where closing the outfit chest using a controller would open it again immediately.
   Fixed a bug where Billy would get stuck inside a shop portal and not teleport away.
   Fixed a bug where some projectiles could fly outside the room in certain angles.
   Fixed a bug where certain outfits would draw weapons at the wrong position on Billy.
